national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Census Progress, ODOP Success, and Nasha Mukt Campaign
bullets: PM Modi noted that the first phase of Census 2027 is nearing completion, having recorded data from over 32 crore families with self-enumeration facilities.
Highlighted the impact of the One District One Product (ODOP) initiative in Pratapgarh, Uttar Pradesh, which now operates around 100 amla processing units.
Announced health check-ups and meditation camps as part of a 100-week drive under the Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan to foster a drug-free youth.

national_news.title: India Retains Nona Gaprindashvili Trophy at 46th Chess Olympiad
bullets: India secured the top overall nation title to win the Nona Gaprindashvili Trophy for the third consecutive edition at the 46th Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.
The Indian men's team won the Silver medal on tie-break with 18 points, finishing behind host nation Uzbekistan.
The Indian women's team clinched the Bronze medal after drawing with Georgia, while China secured the Gold medal in the women's section.

national_news.title: IAF Begins Operational Phase of Multilateral Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026
bullets: The Indian Air Force launched the operational phase of exercise 'Tarang Shakti 2026' at Air Force Station Jodhpur, running from September 26 to October 12, under the theme 'Power in Partnership'.
Seven Friendly Foreign Countries—Australia, USA, UAE, France, Germany, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh—participated with combat platforms including F-35, Rafale, F-16, and A400M.
The exercise focuses on interoperability, mutual operational learning, aerospace safety, and showcasing India's indigenous defence ecosystem.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Stresses Self-Reliance and Future-Ready Capabilities in Defense
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India is building defense capabilities keeping future warfare over the next 10 to 25 years in mind.
Nearly 75 percent of the capital acquisition budget, amounting to Rs 1,39,000 crore, has been earmarked for procurement from the domestic defence industry.
The armed forces have issued five Positive Indigenisation Lists covering 509 defense equipment items and weapon systems to promote self-reliance.

national_news.title: Rajasthan's Cultural and Sporting Legacy Featured in PM Mementos e-Auction 2026
bullets: The Ministry of Culture organized the 8th edition of the PM Mementos e-Auction 2026, featuring 37 artifacts representing Rajasthan's heritage.
The collection includes traditional Pichwai and Phad paintings, handcrafted wooden items, folk deity memorabilia, and Ajmer Sharif Dargah depictions.
The auction portal pmmementos.gov.in hosts the collection until October 2, 2026.

national_news.title: Central Bureau of Narcotics Conducts Anti-Drug Programme Under Mission Yuva Raksha
bullets: The Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN) organized anti-drug awareness programs under 'Mission Yuva Raksha' for the Nasha Mukt Bharat vision in Madhya Pradesh.
Events were held at GT Polytechnic College in Jaora and in Mandsaur in collaboration with the Brahma Kumaris for opium cultivators and youth.
CBN also conducted Jan Sunwayi programs in Neemuch and Mandsaur to address grievances of over 450 opium cultivators regarding the Settlement Operation 2026-27.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Addresses UN General Assembly on Global Security and '4F Crisis'
bullets: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar addressed the UN General Assembly in New York, urging warring nations to de-escalate tensions and ensure uninterrupted supply chains for energy and commerce.
Highlighted the '4F Crisis' impacting the Global South, which includes critical challenges surrounding the security of Food, Fuel, Fertiliser, and Finance.
Showcased India's development partnership with the Global South, citing 600 projects across 78 countries, and advocated for national sovereignty in Artificial Intelligence model development.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Tourism Launches National Digital Tourism Stack with ONDC
bullets: The Ministry of Tourism, in partnership with the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), launched the National Digital Tourism Stack (NDTS) at Bharat Mandapam on World Tourism Day.
The project aims to onboard 23,000 tourism offerings—comprising 14,000 experiences and 9,000 homestays—onto a unified Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) by December 2028.

Supported by the International Centre for DPI Innovation and Advancement (ICDIA), the initiative incorporates AI to implement a 'One ticket, One pass' concept across preparation, pilot (Jan-Jun 2027), and nationwide scale-up phases.

bihar_news.title: ITC Expands Fresh Dairy Footprint in Eastern India with Focus on Bihar
bullets: ITC is expanding its 'Aashirvaad' fresh dairy presence across Bihar, West Bengal, and Jharkhand, establishing itself as the second-largest dairy brand in Bihar.
The company operates dairy processing plants in Bihar across Munger, Patna, Muzaffarpur, and Gaya.
Through 'Project Gomukh', ITC engages with over 40,000 dairy farmers via direct milk sourcing networks to improve milk productivity and rural incomes.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Dismisses Opposition Allegations Over Special Intensive Revision (SIR) Process
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary defended the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process conducted from June 24 to July 25, 2025, calling opposition claims baseless.
Data shared indicates that during the SIR process, 22.34 lakh deceased, 36.28 lakh relocated, and 7 lakh duplicate voter entries were verified and removed.
The Chief Minister noted that similar SIR exercises were previously conducted in Bihar in 2003 and 2025.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Identifies Mineral Reserves Worth Over ₹21,000 Crore to Boost Mining Revenue
bullets: Geological investigations conducted between 2021 and 2024 have identified mineral resources valued at over ₹21,000 crore across Rohtas, Jamui, Gaya, and Jehanabad.
Rohtas accounts for major deposits including 130.11 million tonnes of glauconite (valued at ₹14,048 crore) and high-grade limestone.
Jamui district has emerged as a key zone for magnetite and gold-bearing resources, with state officials eyeing over ₹5,000 crore in annual mining revenue.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Prepares for 2030 FIH Women's Hockey World Cup in Rajgir
bullets: Bihar is preparing to host the 2030 FIH Women's Hockey World Cup in Rajgir, with the state's proposal reportedly accepted.
Discussions regarding the hosting were held during the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, involving Sports Minister Shreyasi Singh and Hockey India officials.
Rajgir has previously hosted the Women's Asian Champions Trophy in 2024 and the Men's Asia Cup in 2025.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Plans Compulsory Computer Education in All Government Schools
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary directed education officials to introduce compulsory computer education across all government schools starting next year.
The proposed framework suggests deploying one computer instructor for every two to three schools.
The initiative aims to modernize school facilities and strengthen academic preparation for competitive examinations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar-born Entrepreneur Piyush Jha Earns UNDP Recognition for Wastewater Innovation
bullets: Piyush Jha, a 20-year-old entrepreneur originally from Madhubani, Bihar, developed an affordable, decentralized wastewater treatment system.
The innovation earned recognition under UNDP India's 'Youth Co:Lab National Innovation Challenge'.
The technology uses microorganisms to break down biodegradable waste from industries like textiles and leather without heavy civil infrastructure while generating electricity.

bihar_news.title: Youth Innovator Recognized by UNDP for Eco-Friendly Wastewater Treatment System
bullets: Piyush Jha, a 20-year-old innovator from Bihar, earned recognition under UNDP India's 'Youth Co:Lab National Innovation Challenge' for developing a modular wastewater treatment system.
The technology utilizes microorganisms to break down biodegradable industrial waste without requiring heavy civil infrastructure or chemical dosing, while generating electricity in the process.
Targeted at high-volume industries like textiles, food processing, and paper, the innovation aims to drastically reduce operational costs and prevent untreated effluent discharge.
